[![KevinGray](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/e/e6/KevinGray.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20210629050319)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/e/e6/KevinGray.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20210629050319)
**Kevin Winfield Gray** is a former Mattel employee and programmer who worked with the company from 1985 to 2009. His official role at Mattel was as both a product designer and as a product developer, developing numerous products and redesigning numerous others. He currently runs his own company, General Anomaly Design LLC.
